instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Read the markdown documents in a folder of my account's files as rows: each document's frontmatter is its fields, with the file's name, folder, size, dates, links, tags and identity, a page at a time", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-namespace-documents-as-list-rows and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: The same rows as tool:read-documents-as-list-rows, read from the person's Namespace files through the run's records door (list_files and read_file, every file read by its name) instead of a folder on their computer.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: undefined (list_files, read_file).
